name: One Pyromancer Seal per caster on each recipient (#5798)
contract: Seal of Alysrazor ranks 1-5 share the chain 800196 -> 802819 -> 802820 -> 802821 -> 802822 (spell_ranks, rev_20260831_01) with unranked Greater Seal of Alysrazor 570170 (same +31 value as rank 5, raid version); Seal of Al'ar ranks 1-5 share the chain 803649 -> 803729 -> 807704 -> 807770 -> 808012 (spell_ranks, rev_20260903_01) with unranked Greater Seal of Al'ar 808060. No spell_group listed the Alysrazor pair and nothing linked the two seals, so Aura::CanStackWith let normal+greater and Seal+Seal stay on one recipient (#5798). Group 1145 with rule 2 (SPELL_GROUP_STACK_RULE_EXCLUSIVE_FROM_SAME_CASTER) makes the newest replace the caster's previous seal while a second Pyromancer's still coexists - the same shape as the Seal of Al'ar (1144) group. Only first ranks are listed because SpellMgr::LoadSpellGroups drops any other rank and chains resolve through GetFirstSpellInChain.

steps.label: Seal of Alysrazor on the ally
Greater Seal of Alysrazor from the same caster
Greater Seal of Alysrazor is applied
It replaced the same caster's Seal of Alysrazor
Seal of Al'ar from the same caster
It replaced the same caster's Greater Seal of Alysrazor
A second Pyromancer gives Seal of Alysrazor to the same ally
The other caster's Seal of Alysrazor coexists (rule 2, not rule 1)
The first caster's Seal of Al'ar is untouched
